paragraphs: Enjoy state-of-the-art technology and comfort-driven care from your trusted dentist in Southport, NC.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort. We're the trusted go-to dentist in Southport, NC, for compassionate care.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

As your trusted dentist in Soutjport, NC, our experienced team of dental professionals is dedicated to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Southport office! Our office stands out with its modern atmosphere and advanced technology, making your dental experience stress-free. Our skillful and attentive team strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we designed our office and amenities with your health and well-being in mind. Our patients feel supported and at ease, leaving motivated and confident to care for their oral health.

Our Southport location is conveniently situated in a suburban community, just off Southport Supply SE and E F Middlton BLVD Intersection. It offers small-town charm with easy access to the North Carolina Woodlands Park & Amphitheater and Waterfront Park. We provide care for the Southport community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Oak Island, Southport, Boiling Spring Lakes, and more. Our connection with clients goes beyond the dental chair. You are now part of the Riccobene family, where we are committed to providing the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, painless smile!
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Bolivia office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!
We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services such as teeth whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment available.
We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

We use digital X-rays, which use a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.
Yes! Our office welcomes patients of all ages. We treat kids, teens, adults, and families.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are available at your Southport Office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

What cosmetic dentistry options do you offer in Southport Office?

We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services such as teeth whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Can I get same-day emergency dental care in Southport?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you provide dental implants and implant-supported dentures in Southport?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment available.

How often should I schedule routine dental checkups in Southport Office?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

Are financing options or dental membership plans available at your Southport location?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

What X-ray technologies do you use to ensure safe and modern dental care in Southport Office?

We use digital X-rays, which use a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.

Does your Southport dentist's office treat patients of all ages, including families?

Yes! Our office welcomes patients of all ages. We treat kids, teens, adults, and families.
